entries.2df22a82967605d7: The highest are [[industry:semiconductors|Semiconductors]] and [[industry:electronics|Electrical Equipment and Electronics]], exceeding 8-tenths of revenue even at the median. Equipment and parts are sold in line with global manufacturing companies, their customers, so these are industries that cannot stand on the domestic market alone. [[industry:pharmaceuticals|Pharmaceuticals]] follows because a high proportion of its companies expand sales of new drugs mainly in Europe and the United States. Meanwhile, the median for [[industry:food|Food]] exceeds 5-tenths because the food companies that disclose information by region are themselves limited to companies expanding overseas with seasonings and beverages, and this is not the picture of the food industry as a whole.

entries.4892d63a698dec5d: How much of their sales do Japanese listed companies obtain overseas? The companies that printed sales by region in the "Information by Region" section of their annual securities reports numbered 71 out of the 3,132 companies listed. This feature tallies the overseas sales ratio (sales outside Japan ÷ total sales by region, a calculated value) for only those 71 companies. Companies that do not provide information by region are excluded from the scope because they are not "without overseas sales" but "unknown."
